description:
Response information for telemetry and debugging.

Aligned with the `response` object that appears on most V4 model results.
All fields are optional because different providers populate different
subsets; traits whose TS spec marks `response` as required use
`ResponseInfo` directly, while those that mark it optional use
`Option<ResponseInfo>`.

id.description: ID of the generated response, when supplied by the provider.

modelId.description: The ID of the model that was used to generate the response.

timestamp.description: Timestamp for the start of the generated response (`toISOString()` in the JSON).
